description: Cache any .NET method with one attribute: a source generator turns [Cache] on interface methods into caching decorators, with keys from the arguments, tag invalidation, Redis or SQL Server, and live policy changes.
rules: Put [Cache] and [CacheInvalidate] on interface methods, never on the implementing class.
Register services first, then call builder.Services.AddMethodCache(); services registered after it are not cached.
Callers must use the interface: calling a cached method from inside its class bypasses the cache.
Don't write keys for [Cache] methods; they come from the method and its arguments.
Tag templates take a parameter name only, like "product:{id}"; "{product.Id}" stays literal text (warning MC0016).
Durations are TimeSpan strings, like Duration = "00:10:00".
Return materialized lists, not IEnumerable<T> or IQueryable<T>, from cached methods.
Use ICacheManager.GetOrCreateAsync with an explicit, prefixed key when an attribute doesn't fit.
